summary: GO Feature Flag is a self-hosted tool designed to manage feature toggles within application codebases. It provides a lightweight alternative to commercial platforms like LaunchDarkly, allowing teams to control feature rollouts without deploying new code. The software is written in Go and distributed under an MIT licence.
goodFor: Development teams looking for an open-source, self-hosted feature flag system that can be integrated into existing infrastructure without vendor lock-in.
watchOut: As an alternative to managed SaaS platforms, you will need to handle your own high availability, backup strategies, and monitoring for the service.
deployNotes: Being a Go binary, it typically compiles into a single executable or runs within a container, though you will generally need to provide persistent storage for flag configurations and a reverse proxy for TLS termination.
